node.statement: Second three-factor replacement. Assuming the same one-factor estimate with d:=2(C_theta+C_Delta)eta and complete contractivity, put P3:=Phi_n(Phi_n(Delta_n X Delta_n Y) Delta_n Z). A two-factor telescope inside the inner Phi_n costs at most 2d||X||||Y|| and replacing the last Phi_n(Delta_n Z) by Delta_n Z costs at most d||Z||, so ||P2-P3|| <= 3d||X||||Y||||Z||.
